snippet.title: Antarctic Sci-Fi Horror | Fear the Flesh Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Free: https://brogrammist.itch.io/fear-the-flesh

A group of Antarctic researchers discover a perfectly preserved meteorite. Isolated in their remote base, their excitement turns to terror after a late-night experiment goes wrong.

Face your fears in this 30-minute sci-fi horror game!
